$comment: The action vocabulary. Generated from client-rs/src/actions.rs and held to it by actions::tests::vocabulary_matches_the_spec. A vendor selects an id and fills the declared parameters; it cannot ship a capability. Patterns are anchored by the client before matching, so a pattern here is a whole-value pattern. An action marked `elevated` needs administrator rights: the client performs it only through its separate helper, on Windows, after Windows' own prompt, and refuses services and variables Windows itself depends on (client-rs/src/elevated.rs).

actions.describes: Set a key in a configuration file
Set how a Windows service starts (administrator)
Set or remove a machine-wide environment variable (administrator)
